GEOSCIENCE
Advancing Knowledge for a Thriving Planet
The Asian School of the Environment (ASE) at NTU is a diverse school focusing on the connections between geosciences, ecology, society and Earth systems. Our approach integrates these disciplines to examine big environmental challenges both in Southeast Asia and globally. We conduct cutting-edge research on topics that include ecology, geohazards, climate change, sea-level rise, environmental sustainability, conservation of environment and biodiversity, and interactions between environment and society.
ASE ranked 13th globally for Environmental Sciences in the 2025 QS World University Rankings by Subject.

Our Undergraduate Programmes
More about our undergraduate programmes, teaching, and students here
Bachelor of Science (Honours) | Environmental Earth Systems Science (EESS)
Our flagship programme, providing students with a strong background in supporting mathematics and science, modern computing techniques, and Earth systems science.
Bachelor of Science (Honours) | Environmental Earth Systems Science and Public Policy and Global Affairs (ESPP)
Double Major Programme that combines Environmental Earth Systems Science with Public Policy and Global Affairs from the School of Social Sciences.
Bachelor of Science (Honours) | Environmental Earth Systems Science with 2nd Major in Data Analytics (ESDA)
Second major programme that combines Environmental Earth Systems Science with Data Analytics
Bachelor of Science (Honours) | Environmental Earth Systems Science with 2nd Major in Sustainability (ESSN)
Second major programme that combines Environmental Earth Systems Science with Sustainability
Bachelor of Science (Honours) | Environmental Earth Systems Science with 2nd Major in Entrepreneurship (ESET)
Second major programme that combines Environmental Earth Systems Science with Entrepreneurship
Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Environmental Earth Systems Science with 2nd Major in Future Foods (ESFF)
Second major programme that combines Environmental Earth Systems Science with Future Foods
Our Graduate Programmes
More about our graduate programmes, handbook, and modules listing here
Doctor of Philosophy | Environmental Science (by research)
As a PhD student in ASE, you will benefit from the interdisciplinary environment, state of the art facilities, and a diverse and collaborative community.
Master by Research | Environmental Science (by research)
ASE Master by Research programme is a 1.5 years to 2 years programme.
Master of Science in Environmental Sustainability Science (by Coursework)
The NTU Asian School of the Environment’s Master of Science in Environmental Sustainability Science (ESS) is a one- to two-year interdisciplinary programme that equips graduates with strong foundations in sustainability science, systems thinking, and effective science communication.
